CustomField.description: How to read Excluded_Individual_Ids__c. All Except Listed is the default and means everyone in the audience was targeted apart from the listed ids. Only Listed means the sender cleared the selection and picked individuals explicitly, so the list is a whitelist. Storing the mode keeps both directions small on the wire: neither a 10,000-strong audience nor a 3-person pick has to post the other side of the set.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Whether the stored id list is an exclusion list or a whitelist.
CustomField.label: Selection Mode
